messages:
maria: quick sync — planning a 'shimmer' deployment pattern for EU small-model variants. goal: opt-in catalog + micro-canary + telemetry gates + automated rollback. posting checklist + flag draft.

alex: shimmer? new name, lol. what behavior does it encode vs normal canary?

tj: real quick: shimmer = very low initial exposure (0.5–2%), only opt-in tenants, shadow at 10% for evals, then widen if gates pass. less noisy than normal canary.

sam: propose telemetry gates: p50_latency_ms <= 250, p95_latency_ms <= 700, error_rate_pct < 0.5, quality_regression_pct < 1.0 (on our eval promptset). also monitor token cost delta < 5%.

maria: adding: hallucination-rate alert (LLMQA heuristic) and customer-reported fallback counts. if any gate trips -> immediate route to baseline model + alert.

kevin: ops question — do we have an automated circuit-breaker hook to remap traffic to baseline and drain the shimmer pool?

ops-bot: circuit-breaker hook template created: /hooks/fallback-remap -> maps shimmer->baseline, marks incident channel #product-shimmer.

alex: flag draft (JSON) below — this lives in config service and is the single source of truth for rollout.

```json
{
  "flag": "shimmer_eu_small_v1",
  "state": "off",
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "opt_in_tenants": ["acme", "beta-inc"],
  "shadow_sample_rate": 0.10,
  "rollback_policy": "auto_on_gate_violation",
  "gates": {"error_rate": 0.005, "p95_latency_ms": 700, "quality_regression_pct": 1.0}
}
```

sam: note — use A/B for UX/engagement tests only after shimmer is stable. shuffle bucketing for opt-ins to avoid cross-tenant leakage.

alex: timeline suggestion: week 0: opt-in catalog + shadowing only; week 1: 0.5% live traffic; week 2: 2% live; widen by 2x per week if gates stable.

maria: launch criteria checklist:
- ops signoff (capacity + autoscale tested)
- 72h no gate violations at each step
- quality evals pass on seed set (regression < 1%)
- legal/privacy clearance for EU opt-ins
- runbook + oncall rota published

tj: owners: maria (product), kevin (ops), sam (quality), alex (routing/flags). who owns opt-in catalog maintenance?

maria: i'll own the catalog + onboarding docs, kevin will do RBAC for tenant opt-ins.

alex: small nit — add cost-signal gate: if per-token cost increases by > 5% for > 1h, auto-fall back.

kevin: ack. will wire cost metric into gates. also adding a graceful-drain command: `/deploy drain shimmer_eu_small --grace-period 60s`.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created: `canary/shimmer_eu_small_v1` -> region: eu-west-1, start: 1759009950 (UTC).

maria: next steps: i'll post a short runbook and schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow. tagging @alex @kevin @sam for quick review. :thumbsup:

alex: review by EOD, thanks.

sam: added a short prompt-suite that will be used for continuous quality checks. dropping it in the docs repo now.

maria: perfect — if no objections we'll flip opt-in switch after docs + runbook.

kevin: no objections from infra side.

alex: good to go from routing.

maria: closing thread — will update when kickoff is scheduled. thanks all!
